name: noterootai
description: NoteRootAI root workspace for running services together

scripts.dev:legacy: concurrently -n "CLIENT,SERVER,AI" -c "cyan,magenta,yellow" "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:ai"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install
scripts.setup:backend: cd backend && python -m venv .venv && .\.venv\Scripts\python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
